journals.name: Scientometrics

metrics.transparencyData: Data Availability Statement required for original research

notFor: field literature reviews without scientometric contribution
descriptive keyword mapping without methodological justification
LLM classification without validation

journals.name: Political Science Research and Methods

metrics.transparencyData: replication data and code required after acceptance

notFor: method-heavy manuscripts without clear political science contribution
case narratives without generalizable mechanism
empirical claims without reproducible data and code

journals.name: Perspectives on Politics
bestFor: high-end research for general political science readers

metrics.transparencyData: data and log files expected for quantitative inference before publication

notFor: narrow subfield manuscripts without broader political science significance
public commentary without scholarly evidence and theoretical contribution
technical papers that do not translate findings for broad political science readers

journals.name: The China Quarterly
bestFor: research reports based on empirical evidence
China-focused social science with strong contextual knowledge

metrics.sjrHIndex: SJR known; H-index verify via SCImago
metrics.transparencyData: context-dependent; explain data, interviews, archives, and evidence-sharing limits

notFor: generic China case studies without China studies engagement
policy commentary without original research and analytical argument
manuscripts that ignore pinyin, Chinese characters, citation, and table/figure style requirements

journals.name: Business and Politics

metrics.sjrHIndex: SJR known; H-index verify via SCImago
metrics.transparencyData: expected for empirical work; explain data, evidence sources, and reproducibility limits

notFor: management manuscripts without political institutions or governance questions
firm performance studies where politics is only a control variable
policy descriptions without a business-government interaction mechanism

journals.name: Review of International Political Economy

metrics.transparencyData: expected for empirical work; explain data, code, and reproducibility limits

notFor: single-country policy studies without IPE theoretical contribution
firm-level studies without global political economy implications
empirical papers whose contribution is only methodological or descriptive

journals.name: New Political Economy

metrics.transparencyData: context-dependent; explain evidence base and data limitations

notFor: neutral policy evaluations without political economy argument
firm strategy papers without power, capitalism, or state-market implications
technical empirical papers without a critical or theoretical contribution

journals.name: Regulation & Governance

metrics.transparencyData: expected for empirical work; explain data, institutional material, and reproducibility limits

notFor: international political economy papers without regulatory governance mechanism
corporate political strategy papers where regulators are only background
policy outcome studies without institutional process evidence

journals.name: Interest Groups & Advocacy

metrics.transparencyData: expected for empirical work; explain coding, data sources, and reproducibility limits

notFor: papers without interest groups, advocacy, lobbying, or policy influence
macro-IPE papers where organizations are not central actors
lobbying-data papers without interest group theory contribution

journals.name: American Journal of Political Science

metrics.editorialSpeed: verify via publisher or editorial reports
metrics.transparencyData: replication materials required in AJPS Dataverse and externally verified

notFor: narrow case studies without general political science contribution
method-heavy manuscripts without a broad political science question
descriptive empirical papers without strong identification, theory, or replication support

journals.name: European Journal of International Relations
bestFor: historical and contemporary theoretically informed empirical research

metrics.transparencyData: data sharing encouraged; Data Availability Statement expected where relevant

notFor: foreign policy case studies without IR theoretical contribution
regional event narratives without conceptual innovation
policy commentary without theory, method, or evidence transparency
